findings.proposition: Partial access was recognised and moved into material implementation through Colabora on 28 August 2026.
The reviewed first tranche contains eight files and 734 pages.
Remaining documents promised for successive delivery under Resolution 154/2026 have not yet been controlled as a complete denominator.

non_inference_rules: Notification, access recognition and delivery do not establish agreement with the project's allegations.
Repeated automated transmissions are not separate resolutions or separate substantive productions.
Official-capacity signature does not establish personal knowledge or responsibility outside the signed act.
First-tranche review does not establish completeness of the staged production.
The production does not prove a public-bond allocation to HNT or an Acosta Matos subscriber bridge.
